summary: Keep status-filtered agent lists fast after messages and fresh after local observations

replay.detail: Only in-memory agent-card cache dependencies change; no replay is requested.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or schema version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest change; coordinated member upgrades are not required.

compatibility.detail: No client-v0, CLI or replication contract change. Filtering still precedes pagination, and existing cursors keep their original cards.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal binary restart; restart timing has not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: Existing installations need no store migration or manual action; identity and stored claims are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No persistent-state change; swapping back to the prior binary retains its prior cache behavior without a data migration.
